greeting.text: Our lamps falter when the current cannot listen back. There is a listening coil in a chest inside the cave south of here. Bring it through the exit and fit it in the socket beside me. Then we can reach Talla in Wamwammigtraawsho.

hint:mission:concordance:current.text: Pella needs a listening coil from the southern cave. Follow the cave marker, take the coil, return through an exit and fit it beside her. Ask Pella about the missing current. Retrieve the listening coil in the southern cave. Fit the coil beside Pella.

story-complete.text: The socket holds. Follow the road marker to Talla Three-Wicks in Wamwammigtraawsho.
